description_en: Verifies the authenticity of enterprise registration information and business operations
description_zh: 企业注册信息真实性及经营真实性验证服务
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth ent-verify --scene-code withdraw --merchant-biz-id 321980000193000 --merchant-user-id 432000421 --user-authorization 1 --info-verify-type '无' --risk-verify-type BUSINESS_ANTIFRAUD --risk-model-version BASIC --license-no 32132000328932 --ent-name '000有限公司' --legal-person-name '张00' --legal-person-cert-no 370105000003892 --legal-person-mobile 130000053 --account-no 32132400038293 --api-version 2022-11-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EntVerify

parameters.help_en: The merchant-defined unique business ID used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value is a combination of letters and numbers with a maximum length of 32 characters. Ensure that the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The merchant-side user ID. The value is a combination of letters and numbers with a maximum length of 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧用户ID。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether user authorization is obtained. Valid values:

- 1: Authorization is obtained.

- 0: Authorization is not obtained
parameters.help_zh:
是否获得得用户授权。

- 1：获得授权

- 0：未获得授权
parameters.name: user_authorization

parameters.help_en: The enterprise element verification type. This parameter is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 企业要素核验类型，当前暂不支持
parameters.name: info_verify_type

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise risk verification type. You must specify at least one of this parameter and InfoVerifyType. Valid values:

- BUSINESS_ANTIFRAUD
parameters.help_zh:
企业风险核验类型，与InfoVerifyType 至少选一个，目前支持：

- BUSINESS_ANTIFRAUD
parameters.name: risk_verify_type

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise risk verification model version. This parameter is required when RiskVerifyType is specified. Valid values:

- BASIC: Basic Edition
parameters.help_zh:
企业风险核验模型版本，RiskVerifyType 不为空时必传，目前支持：

- BASIC：基础版
parameters.name: risk_model_version

parameters.help_en: The ID card number of the legal representative
parameters.name: legal_person_cert_no

parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number of the legal representative
parameters.name: legal_person_mobile

parameters.help_en: The payment receiving account, which helps improve the risk assessment accuracy
parameters.help_zh: 收款账户，辅助提升风险评估效果
parameters.name: account_no
